title: Fix controls profile dropdown padding issue [held-out: broken-parent / revert-of-fix]
author: madicen
body:
This PR addresses an overflow issue when opening the controls profile dropdown, ensuring it fits within the terminal height without padding the detail body.

- Adjusted `ContentTop` for the dropdown panel to account for content offsets.
- Modified `overlayControlsProfile` to use the correct view height and adjust row positioning accordingly.
